verdict.rationale: DPMA's own patent-application page publishes some exact deadlines: one year from filing to claim internal priority, and twelve months from filing to submit a German translation of English or French applications. Nothing in the pack covers late-payment surcharges, penalties, interest, or fee amounts tied to missed deadlines, so only a thin slice of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a published penalty/surcharge and interest schedule with exact figures, a comprehensive deadline list across patents, trade marks and designs, fee amounts, independent corroboration.
